questions.question: Describe the position of Africa on a globe.
questions.expected_answer: Africa lies across the middle of the Earth. The equator crosses it near its middle, so it has land in both the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. It is south of Europe and south-west of Asia.

questions.question: Name Africa's two neighbouring continents and explain how each is connected to or separated from Africa.
questions.expected_answer: Europe lies to the north, separated by the Mediterranean Sea; at the Strait of Gibraltar the two are only about fourteen kilometres apart. Asia lies to the north-east and is joined to Africa by a narrow strip of land in Egypt, through which the Suez Canal was dug.

questions.question: Name the two oceans and two seas around Africa and give the position of each.
questions.expected_answer: The Atlantic Ocean is to the west, the Indian Ocean is to the east, the Mediterranean Sea is to the north and the Red Sea is to the north-east.
